import novamind_api as nm

# Gross rebill calendar: active subs, bill when (day - start_day) % 30 == 0, day > start_day
for label, lo, hi in [("wk26", 176, 182), ("wk27", 183, 189), ("wk28", 190, 196), ("wk29", 197, 203)]:
    mods = ",".join(str(d % 30) for d in range(lo, hi + 1))
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) amt,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day >= 146 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) first_rebills
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
      AND s.start_day < {lo} AND (s.start_day % 30) IN ({mods})
    """)
    row = r['rows'][0]
    print(f"{label} d{lo}-{hi}: {row['n']:6d} rebills gross ${row['amt']:,.0f} (first-timers {row['first_rebills']})")

# 4-week-out monthly gross (whole book bills once per 30d)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(s.effective_price) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
""")
row = r['rows'][0]
print(f"\nFull active book: {row['n']} subs, monthly gross ${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# avg new-sub first payment mix this week
r = nm.query("""
SELECT AVG(s.effective_price) avg_px, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 AND c.customer_type='small' AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
""")
row = r['rows'][0]
print(f"new subs this wk: {row['n']}, avg first payment ${row['avg_px']:.0f}")

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== A. FIRST-REBILL CHURN: cohort d139-145 (rebilled d169-175, post A->T2) vs prior ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan,
  COUNT(*) cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc_this_wk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) still_sub
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 139 AND 145 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan HAVING cohort >= 100 ORDER BY cohort DESC
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    rate = row['canc_this_wk']/row['cohort']*100
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} cohort {row['cohort']:6d} canc {row['canc_this_wk']:5d} ({rate:.0f}%) still {row['still_sub']}")

print("\n=== A2. ALL cancels this week by group/plan (incl. old subs) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== B. Conversion by week x group (wk23,24,25) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, (s.start_day-1)/7 wk, COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day >= 155
GROUP BY c.group_id, wk ORDER BY c.group_id, wk
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    conv = row['subs']/row['leads']*100 if row['leads'] else 0
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} wk{row['wk']}: leads {row['leads']:6d} subs {row['subs']:6d} conv {conv:.0f}%")

print("\n=== C. A-share of new subs (cannibalization check): new subs by plan wk24 vs wk25, S2/S3 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, (s.start_day-1)/7 wk, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id IN ('S2','S3','D_S07','D_S04','D_S10') AND s.start_day >= 162 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, wk ORDER BY c.group_id, wk, s.plan
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== D. Open issues by group ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(nm_day() - i.created_day) avg_age
FROM issues i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.status='open' GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== D. Open issues by group (fixed cols) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(days_open) avg_age
FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} open {row['n']:6d} avg_age {row['avg_age']:.1f}d")

print("\n=== D2. Issues opened/resolved this week by group ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT group_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN open_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opened,
  SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) resolved
FROM issues GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY opened DESC LIMIT 10
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} opened {row['opened']:6d} resolved {row['resolved']:6d}")

print("\n=== E. Active subs by group/plan + usage actuals (d175) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 16
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== E2. Usage vs quota: subs near cap (latest day) by plan ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.plan, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n_subs, AVG(u.units_used) avg_u, MAX(u.units_used) max_u,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.units_used >= CASE s.plan WHEN 'A' THEN 950 WHEN 'B' THEN 285000 ELSE 3990 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) near_cap
FROM daily_usage u JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id=u.subscription_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE u.day=174 AND s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY s.plan, c.group_id ORDER BY n_subs DESC LIMIT 16
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} subs {row['n_subs']:6d} avg_u {row['avg_u']:8.1f} max {row['max_u']:8.0f} near_cap {row['near_cap']:5d}")

print("\n=== F. Ad CAC by channel-group d169-175 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(spend) spend, SUM(leads_generated) leads
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 169 AND 175
GROUP BY channel_id, group_id ORDER BY spend DESC
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    cpl = row['spend']/row['leads'] if row['leads'] else 0
    print(f"{row['channel_id']:18s} {row['group_id']:6s} spend {row['spend']:8.0f} leads {row['leads']:6.0f} $/lead {cpl:.1f}")

print("\n=== G. Cash flow categories this week ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['category']:24s} {row['amt']:12.0f}")
